name: third-party-api-evaluation
description: Evaluate a third-party API for integration fit across functional coverage, contract stability, reliability (SLA + status page + incident history), security (auth, PCI/SOC2/ISO27001), rate limits + quotas, pricing + cost scaling, data residency + GDPR, support + docs quality, lock-in risk, exit strategy. Produces scored evaluation matrix against alternatives, risk register, proof-of-concept plan. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export. Not legal / contractual advice.
